name: I²R Makerspace
description: Innovative Idea to Reality (I²R) Makerspace is a collaborative hub where creativity meets technology, from electronics and fabrication to design and prototyping.
summary: Bring your ideas to life and be part of IIITDM's maker community.

facilities.title: Fabrication
facilities.description: Build and iterate on physical prototypes using the makerspace's fabrication facilities.

facilities.title: Electronics
facilities.description: Develop, test, and integrate electronics for student projects and prototypes.

facilities.title: Design & Prototyping
facilities.description: Turn early concepts into testable designs in a collaborative project environment.

process: Define your project and equipment requirements.
Contact the I²R team for availability and access guidance.
Complete the required orientation before using equipment.
Use the space responsibly during your allotted slot.
